tool.name: Savont: Download reference databases
tool.description: Download Savont reference databases (EMU, SILVA, GreenGenes2, UNITE)
tool.command:
#from datetime import date
#set $today = date.today().strftime('%Y%m%d')
mkdir -p '$out_file.extra_files_path' #if $hide_test && cp -r '$__tool_directory__/test-data/emu-1' 'emu-1' && mv 'emu-1' '$out_file.extra_files_path' && #else savont download --location 'savont_dbs' --dbs #for $db in $dbs '$db' #end for #for $db in $dbs && mv 'savont_dbs/$db' '${db}_${today}' && mv '${db}_${today}' '$out_file.extra_files_path' && #end for #end if cp '$dmjson' '$out_file'

param.name: dbs
param.label: Reference databases to download
param.help: Select one or more Savont reference databases. Each database is downloaded to its own directory and can be used with the Savont classify and Savont SINTAX tools.

tool.help:
This tool downloads and installs Savont reference databases into Galaxy using the Data Manager framework, so they can be selected by the **Savont classify** and **Savont SINTAX** tools.
The available databases (see the [Savont documentation](https://github.com/bluenote-1577/savont) for details) are:
* **emu-1**: EMU 16S rRNA reference database. Curated with a focus on species-level classification. * **silva-138.2**: SILVA 16S rRNA reference database (v138.2). Broad taxonomic coverage. * **greengenes2-2024.09**: GreenGenes2 16S rRNA reference database (2024.09). Broad taxonomic coverage. * **unite-10.0**: UNITE ITS reference database (v10.0) for fungal and other eukaryotic ITS amplicons.
Databases can be several gigabytes in size; make sure your Galaxy installation has enough free disk space before running this data manager.
